Angle° is the observer's horizontal angle from the x-axis (45° = symmetric between walls). corner: in — fold points toward observer (inside room corner, concave). corner: out — fold points away from observer (outside box corner, convex). When exported and folded at the center line, the drawings create the illusion of a cube viewed from the specified position.

dab preview — 0 dabs
Greyscale → dab density. Black fills every grid cell (max density at the chosen pitch); lighter regions thin out via ordered dithering. Set pitch to the smallest spacing your brush/motor can resolve. gamma <1 darkens mid-tones, >1 lightens. jitter randomizes dab position within its cell. By default the needle just dabs each cell (pen down/up) with no well trips; turn on refill in well only for a tool that needs reloading between dabs. Keep vpype off (or linesort-only) — linemerge would fuse dabs into lines.
| | | |
superimposed — 0 layers
individual panels
Lissajous figure: x(t)=sin(a·t+φ), y(t)=sin(b·t) over t∈[0,2π]. freq a / freq b set the frequency ratio. Each of the layers is drawn at an incremented delta: when delta acts on phase it shifts the x-component phase φ (changing the figure's shape); on time it offsets the start parameter (a moving trace of the same closed curve). The superimposed view overlays every layer in one square; grid layout lays them out as separate square panels for plotting (use stacked to plot them all on one square).
| | | | |
spiderweb — 0 segments
Stochastic orb web. radii are the straight spokes from the hub to an irregular outer frame; rings is the number of capture-spiral revolutions (line density). The jitter controls add randomness: angle jit wobbles spoke angles, radius jit roughens each spiral vertex, frame jit varies anchor distance, and sag droops each spiral chord inward toward the hub. The web is fully determined by seed — the preview and the plotted job match exactly; press randomize for a fresh one. Output layers: web_frame, web_radii, web_spiral.
